items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Brother Cornbread [Joseph Thomas] is our cousin.

ctx.x: To put everything in perspective from the first session, we talked a lot about your early days, coming up in New Orleans in the [French] Quarter, about your parents and your family. We said that you had come from a quite extensive musical family. Do have any idea about how many musicians were in your family.

40-some or more. Interrelated. Not all family, but interrelated, like Paul Barbarin, my uncle, who’s my Godfather. He and Jimmie Noone married two sisters. Brother Cornbread [Joseph Thomas] is our cousin. Bibbs Lazard. Do you know Bibbs? He was a drummer, played with . . . Who had the restaurant on Orleans Street?
